decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric with its own product page, close to the established offer, likely performs at or above aspiration, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The semi-transparent bouclé-effect fabric fits the decorative range at low carrying cost, and the firm's slack in a growing industry allows it to stay despite modest website visibility, though the earlier withdrawal of the similar bouclé leno E raises some risk.
Flame-retardant curtain fabric serves the targeted hospitality and contract segment, and its dedicated page signals results meeting aspiration.
The wool-blend double-face fabric supports the move toward renewable materials but conflicts with the goal of fewer hard-to-recycle blends, so it is kept on slack while its results remain uncertain.
Recently launched with its own product page and serving both upholstery and curtain uses, the braided fabric is too new to judge against aspiration and shows clear management commitment.
